surfaces.name: Mode A (classic) full session: self-playing transcript with lock/clear sound markers and final score
Mode B (versus) full session: adds screen-shake marker and attack sound marker on top of mode A behavior
CLI entry handling: --help, default mode without --mode, invalid mode value, exit codes
--smoke self-check flag (alone and combined with --mode b)

findings.observed: Mode A transcript contains 'move 6: attack' with no [sound:attack.wav] and no screen-shake. Mode B's 'move 6: attack' is followed by [sound:attack.wav]. Mode A is documented as single-player clearing; attack mechanics and attack sound effects are documented as mode B features.
findings.expected_basis: app/README.md: 'Mode A (classic): single-player clearing' vs 'Mode B (versus): player vs CPU attack mode ... mode B additionally plays attack sound effects'. Internal cross-mode contrast: the product itself marks attack as audible only in mode B, yet performs an attack move in single-player mode A.
findings.reproduction: From the project directory run: python app/app.py --mode a. Output line 'move 6: attack' appears before 'game over: score 1200'. Reproduced identically 3/3 times (probe-noargs.txt, mode-a-run1.txt, mode-a-empty-stdin.txt). Whether this is a defect or intended flavor requires goal reconciliation in compare.

capability_gaps.detail: README claims block-lock and line-clear sound effects in both modes plus attack sound effects in mode B. This backend observes stdout only; the [sound:*.wav] text markers were read, but actual audibility was never captured. No audio capture backend was declared in the packet.
README claims a screen-shake flash on line clears in mode B. Only the [fx:screen-shake] stdout marker was observed; the visual flash itself is not capturable through the stdout-only backend.

map_notes: Identity verified before play: candidate.json sha256 fe4c5518..., app/app.py b9e399de..., app/README.md 3eb427a7... all match packet/manifest. Entry probe passed: both entry commands launch and stdout was actually read by the observer. Product map: the game is fully non-interactive on this candidate - sessions play out a fixed transcript with no stdin consumption (empty-stdin run byte-identical to inherited-stdin run) and end with 'game over: score 1200' in both modes. Output is deterministic across runs. Mode B exactly matches every documented effect marker (lock, clear, screen-shake, attack); mode A shows lock and clear markers plus an undocumented attack move (F-001). Invalid mode exits 2 with a clean argparse message; --smoke prints SMOKE-OK and suppresses the normal session. No crashes, no tracebacks, no hangs observed on any probed path. Lease: exclusive terminal session held by this observer for candidate cand-good, released at phase end.
